reason: Needs 'is this let-bound name ever reassigned in its scope?'. That requires binding resolution plus assignment search (shadowing, destructuring assignment targets, and the global-script exemption). The port only flags plain `let x` loop variables of for-of/for-in and does not check the body for reassignment. Two of three well-formed-looking fixtures also contain syntax errors. tree-sitter also rejects the valid parenthesised destructuring targets in spread.ts (grammar gap).
